verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents an official MCP server for wiring into AI coding agents (semgrep-mcp) and offers CLI/pre-commit hooks that could gate AI-generated code before commit, but a concrete hands-on probe shows the documented MCP server failing to initialize even with Semgrep correctly on PATH, directly contradicting the 'just works' vendor claim. Missing for 10: a working reproduction of the MCP handshake, and explicit agent-specific guidance (e.g. Cursor/Copilot wiring docs) beyond the MCP page and generic CLI/pre-commit docs.
